tests.expected: Canonical replay order/bytes, air prefix, negative/extreme positions, LED colours/fractional geometry/model references, copy isolation and outside edits, failed visitor reuse, invalid-resolution rejection, multiplayer and protocol regressions.
tests.observed: All 135 tests passed. Three new tests compare streaming/list output to an independent legacy leaf-list oracle; serialized edit bytes match. Whole-cell indexed history matches ordered fallback replay, including clearing old fractional entries and preserving unrelated edits. Source history/trees remain unchanged. Visitor runtime failures propagate and the frozen source remains reusable. Wrong resolution rejects before history mutation.

integration_playtest: Playtest: actual TLS multiplayer server and synthetic protocol clients passed four rotations, empty dependency caches, conflict/cancellation, undo, late join and restart. Default three clients; not 32 rendered clients or shaped-network qualification.

probe.method: Separate JVMs, parent first, no concurrent tests/native. Three warmups and 20 builds of canonical indexed history from 64 frozen checkerboard LED cells, 2048 leaves/cell. Each timed build includes Edit/key/map construction. Ordered serialized Edit hash and source leaf counts checked outside timing after every build. Allocation is current-thread allocated bytes, not retained or peak memory. Hash checking can influence later GC; this single ordered comparison is not randomized full-system qualification.
probe.decision: Retain lower-allocation traversal. Median time regressed by 12.420 ms in this diagnostic; p95/worst fell. Do not claim reduced median latency or a 100 ms main-thread bound. Persistent history/edit/key/map costs remain unchanged.

native_playtest.expected: Production Main capture/library/import/export, all rotations, conflict/empty-source policy, cancellation/malformed failure, undo, repeat placement, restart and existing inventory/model editor.
